name: Pinecone Developer MCP Server
summary: Pinecone's MCP server for coding assistants: search Pinecone docs, configure and manage indexes, upsert data and query indexes from Cursor, Claude and others.
description: Runs locally with `npx -y @pinecone-database/mcp` (Node.js 20+) and a `PINECONE_API_KEY`; without a key it can still search the documentation. Pinecone also offers a separate Assistant MCP server per Pinecone Assistant, available as a managed remote endpoint or a self-hosted Docker container.
